text:
Click this button ![icon](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp134-img1.png) to open [Street view](#kw:navigating-street-view:ce-express-street-view) tool.
This interface links a 2D map with a street-level view. The map shows spatial context and landmarks. The street view shows the real-world appearance of the same location. Both panels update together when you select a place.
![Image p134](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp134-img2.png)
